summary: Accepted L01.3 after complete author terminal report and actual PRD diff review. Independent labels, lineage-aware immutable partitions and pre-tuning holdout are documented. Metrics separate candidate recall, assessment precision, end-to-end recall, abstention and operational incompleteness, with direct counts distinct from population estimates. Manual misses do not receive fabricated inclusion probabilities. V07 is present; OPEN-02 names pre-corpus, pre-labeling and qualification gates without selecting numeric thresholds or a qualifying combination.
